components.name: Alert
components.description: Displays a short, dismissible status message to draw attention to important information (success confirmations, warnings, errors, etc.). Use it to surface feedback about the result of an action or the current state of the page.
components.notes: Danger-variant alerts use role="alert" (assertive); all other variants use role="status" (polite).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style and ARIA role of the alert.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading rendered above the alert's description.

props.name: children
props.description: The alert's main message content.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user clicks the dismiss (×) button. If omitted, no dismiss button is rendered.

components.example:
<Alert variant="success" title="Changes saved">
  Your profile has been updated.
</Alert>

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Displays a person's picture, or their initials as a fallback when no image is provided or the image fails to load. Use it to represent a user or account in lists, headers, or comments.
components.notes: By default the avatar exposes the person's name to assistive tech (role="img" + aria-label, or image alt text). Set decorative when nearby visible text already names the person, to avoid the name being announced twice.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name. Source for the fallback initials and the accessible/image alt text (unless decorative is set).

props.name: src
props.description: URL of the image to display. Falls back to initials if omitted or if the image fails to load.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the avatar.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Set when adjacent visible text already names the person, hiding the avatar from assistive tech.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Renders a small, inline label used to tag an item with a status, category, or count (e.g. "New", "Beta", an unread count). Use it for a compact, non-interactive visual marker alongside other content.

props.name: children
props.description: The label content rendered inside the badge, typically a short word or count.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the badge.

components.name: Button
components.description: A clickable button styled to match the design system, for triggering actions such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.
components.notes: All standard button HTML attributes (onClick, disabled, type, etc.) are supported and passed through to the underlying <button>.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button.

components.name: Card
components.description: A container that groups related content in a bordered, padded surface. Use it for discrete blocks of content (list items, summary panels, dashboard tiles, etc.) that should read as a single unit.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the card.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: A paired start/end date selector, rendered as a <fieldset> containing two Input fields of type 'date'. Use it whenever a user needs to pick a bounded date range (e.g. filtering a report by date). Controlled: always reflects value and reports changes via onChange.
components.notes: Each field's bounds constrain the other to keep the range valid: the start field's max is the selected end date (or the max prop), and the end field's min is the selected start date (or the min prop). Renders as <fieldset>/<legend> so screen readers announce the fields as related; when error is set, the fieldset gets aria-describedby pointing at a role="alert" message.

props.name: label
props.description: Label grouping the two date fields, rendered as the <fieldset> legend.

props.name: value
props.description: The current start/end selection. Always pass alongside onChange (controlled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever either date field changes, with the full updated { start, end } value.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Label for the start date field.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Label for the end date field.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation error message, rendered below the fields with role="alert".

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for the start field.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for the end field.

components.example:
<DateRangePicker
  label="Reporting period"
  value={range}
  onChange={setRange}
  min="2024-01-01"
  max="2026-12-31"
/>

components.name: Icon
components.description: Renders a single icon from the design system's icon registry as an inline SVG. Use it anywhere a small, currentColor-tinted vector graphic is needed (buttons, status indicators, etc.).
components.notes: By default the icon is purely decorative (aria-hidden="true"). Pass title to expose it to assistive technology as a named image (role="img" with an SVG <title>) when the icon conveys meaning not otherwise available as text nearby (e.g. an icon-only button).

props.name: name
props.description: Which icon from the registry to render.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size of the icon.

props.name: title
props.description: When provided, the icon becomes an accessible image with this as its accessible name.

components.name: Input
components.description: A single-line text field with a required, associated label and optional inline validation error. Use it any time you need a labelled native <input> (text, email, date, etc. via the native type prop) inside a form.
components.notes: The label is linked to the input with htmlFor/id (auto-generated via useId if no id is passed). When error is set, the input gets aria-invalid="true" plus aria-describedby pointing at the role="alert" error message.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label rendered above the input and associated via htmlFor/id. Required — no unlabeled inputs are allowed.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation error message. When set, renders a role="alert" message below the input and marks it aria-invalid.

components.example:
<Input
  label="Email address"
  type="email"
  value={email}
  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
  error={emailError}
/>

components.name: Modal
components.description: A focused, modal dialog rendered into document.body via a portal, used to interrupt the user with a task or piece of information that requires their attention before continuing.
components.notes: Exposes role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and aria-labelledby pointing at the title. While open: focus moves to the dialog, Escape calls onClose, and background scrolling is locked. On close/unmount, focus is restored to the previously focused element. Focus is moved to the dialog container only — it is not trapped/cycled within the dialog's interactive children.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is currently visible. When false, the component renders nothing.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the user requests to close the modal (Escape key, backdrop click, or the close button).

props.name: title
props.description: Heading content rendered in the modal header and linked to the dialog via aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content rendered inside the dialog.

components.example:
<Modal open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} title="Delete item">
  Are you sure you want to delete this item?
</Modal>

components.name: Select
components.description: A native <select> dropdown with a required, associated label, an optional placeholder option, and optional inline validation error. Use it when a user must pick one value from a known, bounded list of options.
components.notes: The label is linked to the select with htmlFor/id (auto-generated via useId if no id is passed). When error is set, the select gets aria-invalid="true" plus aria-describedby. Keyboard interaction (opening, arrow-key navigation, typeahead) is provided by the browser's native <select>.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label rendered above the select and associated via htmlFor/id. Required — no unlabeled selects.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: When true, visually hides the label while keeping it as the select's accessible name — use for compact contexts like a table cell.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation error message. When set, renders a role="alert" message below the select and marks it aria-invalid.

props.name: options
props.description: The list of selectable options, rendered in order as native <option> elements.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Optional placeholder text shown as a disabled, hidden first option when no real option has been chosen yet.

components.example:
<Select
  label="Country"
  placeholder="Select a country"
  options={[
    { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
    { value: 'ca', label: 'Canada' },
  ]}
  value={country}
  onChange={(e) => setCountry(e.target.value)}
/>

components.name: Spinner
components.description: An animated indicator that communicates an in-progress, indeterminate operation (e.g. data fetching or async form submission). Use it whenever content isn't ready to render yet and you need to signal that work is happening.
components.notes: The root element uses role="status" so assistive technology announces the label text as a live region update; the icon itself is purely visual.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the spinning icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label announced to screen readers via the status live region; not shown visually.

components.name: Table
components.description: Renders tabular data with a horizontally-scrollable wrapper for narrow viewports. Compose it with TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeaderCell, and TableCell to build the table structure explicitly, the same way you would with plain HTML table elements.

components.name: TableHead
components.description: Semantic wrapper for a table's header row group (<thead>). Use it to group the TableRow/TableHeaderCell elements that make up the column headings.

components.name: TableBody
components.description: Semantic wrapper for a table's body row group (<tbody>). Use it to group the data TableRow/TableCell elements.

components.name: TableRow
components.description: A single row (<tr>) within a TableHead or TableBody.

components.name: TableHeaderCell
components.description: A header cell (<th>) identifying a column (or row) within a TableRow.
components.notes: Defaults the native scope attribute to 'col' if not provided; pass scope="row" for row headers.

components.name: TableCell
components.description: A standard data cell (<td>) within a TableRow.

components.name: ToastProvider
components.description: Provides the toast() API (via ToastContext) to its subtree and renders queued toasts into a portal at document.body. Wrap your application (or the relevant subtree) once near the root; descendants then call useToast() to queue notifications.
components.notes: The toast viewport is rendered with aria-live="polite", so assistive technology announces new toasts without stealing focus. Each toast auto-dismisses after its duration (see ToastOptions) and can also be dismissed manually via the underlying Alert's dismiss control.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that gains access to the toast() API via useToast().

components.name: useToast
components.description: Reads the toast API from context, giving components a toast() function to queue toast notifications. Must be called from a descendant of ToastProvider.
components.notes: Throws an Error if called outside of a ToastProvider.

returns.description: An object containing the toast(options: ToastOptions) function used to queue notifications.

types.name: AlertVariant
types.description: Visual style of an Alert, which also determines its icon and ARIA role.

types.name: IconSize
types.description: Available rendered sizes for Icon, mapped to CSS modifier classes.

types.name: IconName
types.description: Names of the icons available to render via <Icon name="..." />.

types.name: SelectOption
types.description: A single choice rendered as a native <option> inside a Select.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Text displayed to the user for this option.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: When true, renders the option disabled so it cannot be chosen.

types.name: DateRangeValue
types.description: The current start/end selection of a DateRangePicker, as ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: start
fields.description: Start of the range, as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: end
fields.description: End of the range, as an ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

types.name: ToastOptions
types.description: Options passed to toast() (from useToast()) describing a single toast notification.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Optional heading rendered as the toast's title.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Main message content of the toast.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Visual style of the toast, forwarded to the underlying Alert. Defaults to Alert's default variant ('neutral').

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Milliseconds before the toast auto-dismisses. Pass 0 to require a manual dismiss. Defaults to 5000.
